# CredVerse Agent Team

Use `/agent-router` for automatic role selection.

The router will:
- select the best primary role for the task,
- add collaborators for multi-domain work,
- dynamically choose the minimum skill and tool set needed,
- enable parallel swarm lanes for independent sub-tasks,
- require message-bus style handoffs between collaborating agents.

Manual role prompts are still available:
- `product-lead.prompt.md`
- `ux-lead.prompt.md`
- `frontend-lead.prompt.md`
- `mobile-lead.prompt.md`
- `backend-lead.prompt.md`
- `data-ml-lead.prompt.md`
- `security-lead.prompt.md`
- `qa-lead.prompt.md`
